# IluMap

> IluMap is a static, browser-based vector map editor for game worlds (islands, zones, rivers, roads, walls, points of interest). The whole map lives in one diff-friendly text file, `map.json`, in world units with stable ids. An AI agent never needs the browser: it reads and edits `map.json` and uses a single-file, dependency-free Node CLI to validate, format, describe the map as text, render SVG, and see what a human changed.

## Quick start

Needs Node 20+ and nothing else:

```bash
curl -O https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/ilumap.mjs
node ilumap.mjs text map.json
```

Editing next to a human in a browser: `node tools/serve.mjs <project folder>` (from the IluMap repo) serves the editor at http://localhost:8765/?file=<path/to/map.json>; the human's Save writes the file, your edits on disk show up in their editor within seconds.

`node ilumap.mjs --help` lists every command (validate, fmt, text, list, svg, mask, terrain, diff, version, and any added later).

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/docs/AGENT.md): commands, the human–agent loop, file-safety rules
- [Format reference](https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/docs/FORMAT.md): every field of map.json
- [JSON Schema](https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/schema/map.schema.json): machine-checkable format
- [Example map](https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/examples/demo/map.json): a 40 km archipelago with POIs, zones, walls and links
- [Editor](https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/): the browser app the human uses (Open file / Open folder, Save)
- [Single-file CLI](https://ilumetric.github.io/IluMap/ilumap.mjs): generated bundle of tools/ilumap.mjs

## Rules

- Reference things by id (`mine_old`), never by name or index; ids are `[a-z0-9_]+`, unique, and never change once lore uses them.
- Add a POI whose exact spot you do not know with `"placed": false` and rough `x`, `y`; the human drags it into place in the editor.
- After every edit run `node ilumap.mjs fmt map.json` and `node ilumap.mjs validate map.json`.
- Distances between places: `node ilumap.mjs route map.json <from-id> <to-id>` measures along roads (bridges, rivers, faults on the way); `text` does the same for road/path/rail links.
- After the human edited the map, run `node ilumap.mjs diff map.json --git` (or `diff old.json new.json`) to see what moved, instead of re-reading everything.
- Never overwrite a newer file from the human: re-read `map.json` right before editing and write only your change on top of it.
